The Mason Jar restaurant opened at 100 E. King St. in Shippensburg, featuring a selection of American dishes including burgers, sandwiches, pork chops, meatloaf, mac and cheese, prime rib, ham pot pie, soups, salads, appetizers, desserts, and drinks. Gwynn's on King, an expansion of the locally owned luxury department store Gwynn's of Mount Pleasant, will open at 154 King St. in downtown Charleston. An official opening date has not been announced; the store is targeting a late summer debut.

Barnes & Noble opened for a soft opening at the Blackmore Marketplace in Casper, Wyoming, on Tuesday, with doors opening at 10 a.m. to customers lined up outside. Slice House by Tony Gemignani is opening a second Idaho location at 676 S. Edgewood Lane in Eagle, in the East End Marketplace development off Idaho 44. No specific date has been set, but the opening is expected in August.

Charli, which occupied the space for more than 50 years, closed at the end of May.

Plaza 136, a new multi-tenant building on the site of a former auto shop in Fisher, IL, is set to house Hot Nails & Spa LLC, which expects to open in September 2026. The building was developed by Abraham Martinez of Topline General Construction and contains six units, three of which are already under contract. Dear Annie, a natural wine bar in Cambridge, MA, will close on July 31, 2026, with owner Lauren Friel citing operational challenges, motherhood, and a restaurant scene she describes as increasingly corporate. Friel also owns Rebel Rebel wine bar in Somerville and noted she has watched many independent food businesses close in the past year. The space will be repurposed for bespoke events starting sometime in September, also led by Friel.

data.location: One Madison Avenue, Manhattan, New York, NY
data.short_description: Alidoro, a 40-year-old Italian sandwich company, is opening a new 1,000-square-foot location at One Madison Avenue in Manhattan on July 9, 2026, marking the brand's 40th anniversary. The restaurant will be open seven days a week and follows the brand's traditional Italian paninoteca concept with open sandwich stations and visible slicing areas. Alidoro is also participating in NYC Tourism's Kick It in NYC Match Day dining at its Rockefeller Center location from July 6–19.

The Andes General Store & Deli has reopened under new ownership after being closed for two years, resuming its role as a community hub in the hamlet of Andes, NY. New owners Kasta Damianos and June Bee conducted renovations and refurbishments starting in May before a soft opening over Memorial Day weekend. The store is now fully open seven days a week, offering groceries, fresh baked goods, deli items, and a dine-in atmosphere.

data.location: Balboa Street near Fifth Avenue, San Francisco, CA
data.short_description: Ghien Banh Mi & Cafe, a new Vietnamese sandwich shop and cafe, began its soft opening on Balboa Street in San Francisco's Inner Richmond neighborhood in May 2026. The shop was started by Tuan Luu and Uyen Vu, who also own the adjacent Luxury Spa nail salon, after roughly a year of permitting, construction, and renovation work. The menu centers on bánh mì sandwiches, fruit teas, and Vietnamese drip coffee.

Cowgirl Coffee has opened its eighth location in the Flathead Valley in downtown Columbia Falls, MT. Unlike previous drive-through-only locations, this new spot will offer a walk-in option, sit-down seating, and an extended food menu including healthy grab-and-go breakfast options and dirty soda drinks. The coffee shop was originally founded in 2002 on Wisconsin Avenue in Whitefish and now has locations in Whitefish, Columbia Falls, and Kalispell.

data.store_name: Mountain Mike's Pizza (Rogue Fare LLC — Oregon locations)
data.location: Medford (2 locations), Klamath Falls, Grants Pass, and Roseburg, OR
data.short_description: Rogue Fare LLC, which operates five Mountain Mike's Pizza restaurants in Oregon, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on July 1, 2026 in the US Bankruptcy Court for the District of Oregon in Eugene. The petition listed assets between $0 and $50,000 and debts between $1 million and $10 million. Mountain Mike's stated that the affected locations remain open and operating as usual, calling the filing an isolated incident and a financial restructuring for one franchise partner.

Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers exited the Chicago market after its Crystal Lake location shuttered in fall 2025, the apparent last remaining local restaurant following closures tied to franchisee M&M Custard's bankruptcy, which had closed 11 Illinois locations. Court documents described Freddy's Chicago business as a "toxic asset generating negative EBITDA." Despite the Chicago exit, the chain continues to operate 13 Illinois locations outside the Chicago area and is on pace to open about 60 restaurants nationally in 2026.

Half Price Books has acquired the former Soundwaves space at 3509 Montrose Blvd in Houston for a new store expected to open next year, marking the chain's return to the Montrose neighborhood after closing its previous location at 1011 Westheimer in 2021. The company confirmed the acquisition after the deed for the property was transferred to an LLC owned by Half Price Books. Half Price Books currently has six locations in greater Houston including Westchase, Pearland, Sugar Land, Humble, Copperfield, and Clear Lake.

data.short_description: Sam's Club filed plans with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation for a new ~166,000 sq ft warehouse store on the Far Westside of San Antonio. Following Foot Locker's acquisition by Dick's Sporting Goods, underperforming Foot Locker stores are set to close in 2026, though the exact number of locations was not disclosed. Dick's Sporting Goods Executive Chairman cited the need to close unproductive stores as part of the integration strategy.
470 GameStop locations across 43 states are set to close in 2026 due to declining foot traffic and rising operating costs. As of February 2025, there were 2,325 GameStop locations in total.
